items.text: Based on feedback from our players, we’ve made various bug fixes, balancing changes, and optimization improvements with the 1.4 Update.
Fixed an issue where items placed after purchasing Bank 3 would return to their original purchase location after saving and loading the game. Items will now remain where you placed them.
Fixed an issue that could cause Customer Chat to disappear in certain situations.
Fixed several inconsistencies in the Desk Upgrade system.
Fixed an issue where the number display on desks could disappear after saving and loading the game.
Various optimizations have been made to improve overall game performance.
To make progression more balanced, the purchase price of Bank 3 has been updated to $800,000.

notes.title: Banker Simulator Is Coming to Consoles!

items.text: Banker Simulator continues to grow! We’re incredibly excited to bring the journey that started on PC to consoles.
Banker Simulator is coming to PlayStation in October. And Xbox is next! Banker Simulator will also be released on Xbox during October.
We’ll continue developing Banker Simulator and improving the overall gameplay experience. We read all of your comments and feedback.
Thank you for your continued support. Please keep sharing your feedback with us!

We are continuing to work on the next major update for Banker Simulator. With this update, we plan to add long-awaited important features and much more extensive content to the game.
One of the most requested additions is finally coming to the game: the big bank system.

With the new update, players will step into a larger, more advanced, and much more intense banking experience. As your bank grows, your responsibilities will increase, and the processes you need to manage will become more comprehensive.
This new structure is one of the features we have been working on the most to take the Banker Simulator experience to the next level.
Alongside the big bank, many new details are also being added to the game.

We are working on new systems, improvements, and extra content that will enrich the gameplay. Our goal is to offer more options, more responsibility, and a more satisfying sense of progression while managing your bank.
We are not sharing all the details for now, but this update will be a very important step for Banker Simulator.
Our preparations for the next update are still ongoing.
We continue to read your comments, suggestions, and feedback. Developing the game together with you is very valuable to us.
Please keep sharing your feedback and stay tuned for the next major update.

items.text: With this hotfix, new features have been added and several issues have been fixed. We continue improving the game to make it more balanced and stable based on your feedback.
Skill system added. As you gain skills, the amount of money you can place on the tray increases and machine speeds improve percentage-wise.
Bank check system added. Customers can bring checks to cash out. You can process them for a commission, but be careful as fake checks are also in circulation.
Fixed an issue where money earned in the casino would disappear if there was no space in safes.
Game balance has been slightly softened.
Fixed an issue where the cleaner was not cleaning graffiti.
Minor bug fixes applied.
Optimization improvements made.
Your feedback is very valuable to us. We will keep improving Banker Simulator. Enjoy the game!

We would like to share some important innovations coming to the game with the new update. Here is a look at what we are working on:
Customers will now start coming to the bank to cash their checks. However, you must be careful as not every check is reliable.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/44c750a6d154200e9e92e9c1f0e589583b335c16.gif"]
Some customers will attempt to use forged signatures.
Others will bring invalid or expired checks. Detecting these frauds depends entirely on your attention to detail.
The carrying system is becoming much more powerful and fluid.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/122e65a1a0d684ed82fb48d26829415472a2c3c7.gif"]
While you start by carrying items one by one, as you unlock skills, you will be able to carry 2, 3, 5, or even 7 items at once.
These improvements will also apply to the Banknote Master skill. Additionally, the skill system is not limited to this; we have 1-2 more new features currently in development.
As always, performance improvements and bug fixes are included in this update to provide a smoother experience.
We read every single one of your comments and continue to develop the game together. Thank you for your support.
Please continue to provide your feedback.

items.text: Foreclosure system has been completely overhauled and revised; 3 new houses added.
“Valuable Items” with sentimental value added to some customers; the decision to seize them is now up to your conscience.
You can now track all loaners and foreclosure processes via the tablet.
Added the ability to open/close the bank via the tablet.

Hiring Workers: You are now required to make a donation to the state to hire employees.
Fixed FPS drops and all captured bugs in the later stages of the game. A more stable experience awaits.
Fixed the issue of consecutive police visits.
Fixed the bug where money couldn't be given to some customers during withdrawals.
General system improvements.
We are making the game better every day thanks to your feedback. Enjoy the game!

With this hotfix, several important issues that some of our players have been experiencing for a long time have now been fully resolved.
Especially the 20:00 bug, which affected many users, has been carefully analyzed and fixed.
In addition, major improvements have been made in terms of stability and overall gameplay performance.
The 20:00 bug was resolved with the help of one of our players, who shared their files with us and worked together with our team to analyze what was causing the issue.
Based on this cooperation, the root cause was identified and necessary preventive measures were implemented.
The fix has now been tested on 20 to 30 different PCs, and the problem has not reoccurred.
If anyone experiences this issue again, please let us know immediately.
An issue where ATMs could sometimes duplicate and lose some of their functionality while moving to the second bank has been fixed.
In later stages of the game, some players were experiencing FPS drops and performance instability.
These issues have been addressed, and the game now runs in a much more stable manner.
A problem where some customers gathered at spawn points and did not move anywhere, creating congestion, has been fixed.
An issue where no customers would arrive at the bank in certain situations has been resolved.
We continue to improve the game every day thanks to your valuable feedback.
Your reports and suggestions play a very important role in shaping the future of Banker Simulator.
Please continue to share your experiences with us.
Enjoy the game.

releases.displayName: 🔧 Banker Simulator – Stability & Environmental Systems Update

items.text: (Performance, Lighting, Fog, Day/Night Reconstruction)
This update was prepared to permanently resolve crash issues, GPU errors and performance drops experienced by some players.
We reworked the game’s infrastructure from the ground up, removed old heavy systems and replaced them with fully optimized in-house solutions.
GPU reset errors have been fixed
Freezing and stuttering issues are significantly reduced
Overall stutter is minimized
Full compatibility with NVIDIA GTX GPUs has been achieved
We also removed the heavy third-party environmental system that handled the day–night cycle, lighting, time management and fog.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/d33340cedd1fbc41e9267f2cc4c740fea6b868c1.jpg"]
This system created unnecessary CPU and GPU load. It has now been replaced with a fully optimized developer-made structure:
New custom time system
New day–night cycle
New lighting system
New fog system
This new structure runs lighter, faster and far more stable.
Fixed an optimization issue caused by empty ink pooling on the ground.
Fixed a bug where upgrading machines did not increase their durability.
Your feedback is very valuable to us. Please share any issues you encounter.
Thank you for your support and happy gaming! 🎮✨
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/79f24103bab3b4891a6098a0aaf104fc2052fd28.jpg"]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499220/Gamer_Stop_Simulator/"]
With EA 0.2.6, we introduced major foundational performance upgrades. We focused heavily on CPU load, stuttering, FPS drops, and stability issues in higher stages of the game. Here’s what’s new:
The entire NPC system has been rebuilt.
The old system caused high CPU usage, stutters, and occasional crashes.
Each customer pulled from the Pooling system generated 103 ms and 27 MB GC Alloc.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/8fc993744176a314fb799f052a4133c69766f4ee.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/9a1b40107ad5191783aabddb933632977eaeea93.jpg"]
As banks expanded and ATM counts increased, customer traffic multiplied and caused massive spikes.
With the new system, these spikes are gone. NPC logic now processes at 7–8 ms, maintaining stability.
To keep 60 FPS, each frame must stay under 16 ms, and the new NPC architecture now supports that consistently.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/82d14affca958e5043cf7b4ebdafcf5e943e9d7d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/15dbeb252e78b8ae62f66944ad9322d1bd29b880.png"]
A major long-term performance improvement.
The game now compiles through IL2CPP instead of Mono.
More stable performance
Faster runtime
Lower CPU usage
Better memory efficiency
Especially noticeable during long sessions.
The Main Menu has been refreshed with a cleaner and more modern look.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/9ead0a1b0481ea4bcbae30101409b1f1a91a6779.gif"]
Various small issues have been fixed and systems were stabilized.
Lighting and post-processing inside bank interiors have been improved.
Environments now appear clearer and more visually polished.
Your feedback is very valuable to us. Please share any issues you encounter.
Thank you for your support and happy gaming! 🎮✨
